_doc: Single source of truth for the audio review: what every manifest key should sound like and when the game plays it. Read by tools/audio/review.py (review player + docs/AUDIO_REVIEW.md). `python3 tools/audio/review.py --check` fails if this and assets/audio/manifest.json disagree.

pistol_fire.expect: Real .45 handgun BLAST, not a pop: bright crack over a deep boom and a noise blast, a hint of slide clack, then forest slap-back echoes and a ~1 s outdoor tail.

smg_fire.expect: Real SMG (PPSh): loud, dense, punchy bark with a low-mid body under each crack, one quick slap-back, ~0.3 s each so 900 rpm bursts stay crisp.
smg_fire.when: Every Carrot SMG shot (900 rpm, full auto).

rifle_fire.expect: AR-15-style rifle: sharp crack over a solid boom (between the pistol and the shotgun), then slap-back echoes and a ~0.8 s outdoor tail.
rifle_fire.when: Every Carrot Assault Rifle shot (600 rpm, full auto).

lmg_fire.expect: Heavy, deep 7.62 shots: chunkier and lower than the rifle with a dark low-mid body and less fizz on top, faint belt rattle, ~0.45 s each.
lmg_fire.when: Every Carrot LMG shot (720 rpm, full auto).

shotgun_fire.expect: Regular 12-gauge pump: big boom with an audible low-mid body and low-end punch, real outdoor slap-backs, then a long rolling tail (~1.5 s).

sniper_fire.expect: .30-06 bolt rifle: huge crack over a deep, heavy thud, then a long rolling echo fading over ~2.6 s, with no dip in between.
sniper_fire.when: Every shot from The Long Carrot (sniper).

rocket_fire.expect: Deep whoosh-thump back-blast, the rocket motor roaring away, crackly sizzle (~2 s).

rocket_whoosh_loop.expect: Steady sputtery rocket roar with a slight spiralling wobble; the loop seam must be inaudible.
rocket_whoosh_loop.when: Loops on every rocket carrot in flight.

rumbler_fire.expect: A buzz-saw rattle at 1,200 a minute: short, tight AK cracks with a low thump and a tick of the belt; a stream of them must stay a rattle, not a smear.
rumbler_fire.when: Every Root Rumbler shot (your arsenal), once its barrels are spinning.

rumbler_spin.expect: Looping electric-motor whine with the barrels whirring past and a light rattle; the game pitches it up as the barrels wind up, so it rises into a whine. No click at the loop seam.
rumbler_spin.when: While the Root Rumbler's barrels spin (winding up, firing, running down).

lobber_fire.expect: A hollow THOONK: a launcher's pop, not a gunshot; round and low, with the drum clicking round just after.

big50_fire.expect: A cannon: deeper and heavier than the sniper, a huge sub thump, slap-back echoes and a long rolling tail.

explosion.expect: Heavy, real-sounding blast: low boom, crunchy body, debris pattering down (~2 s).

shotgun_pump.expect: Real pump rack, "chk ... CHK": the forend slides back to the rear stop, then slams forward and locks (the louder stroke); crisp, no thuddy undertone.
shotgun_pump.when: Shotgun: racked 0.45 s after every shot (the burst preview plays it).

sniper_bolt.expect: Bolt cycle ending in a firm chk-CLACK as it snaps into place: dull lift tick, bolt pulled back onto its stop and shoved forward, then the handle slams down (the loudest hit); dead steel, no ringing clinks or tinkles.

scope_in.expect: Soft, quick rising "zip" with a gentle tone and a tiny click at the end.

reload_start.expect: Grip rustle, a two-part magazine-release click, the magazine sliding out with a solid clack, caught in the off hand.
reload_start.when: Start of every reload; also crate locks.

reload_end.expect: Magazine seated firmly (clack), then the bolt release slams the bolt home (CHAK, the loudest part) at ~0.12 s; over in ~0.25 s.

dry_fire.expect: Small, dry metallic click with a puff of air.
dry_fire.when: Pulling the trigger on an empty gun.

weapon_swap.expect: Quick draw: cloth/strap rustle, small sling-swivel rattle, a grip pat, ending in a sharp safety click-clack.

melee_swing.expect: One heavy "vwoomp" of air as a bat-sized club swings past (rising, then falling away), a low push under it; no sword whistle or ring.
melee_swing.when: Every club swing (each species' melee weapon, with empty paws).

carrot_impact_dirt.expect: Hard, heavy thump into the ground with a dirt-and-grass crunch, a dirt spray and a few clods falling back.
carrot_impact_dirt.when: Carrots hitting the ground, rocks, props.

carrot_impact_wood.expect: One woody THOCK with a small splinter crack fused into the hit (no second 'tik').

carrot_impact_flesh.expect: Solid punch into something soft: a thick, wet, meaty squelch with a dull thud under it; no water-droplet blips or bubbly 'bloops'.
carrot_impact_flesh.when: Your carrots hitting a critter (hit confirm).

headshot.expect: Comedic hollow BONK with falling pitch and a little cork pop (both takes).

gore_splat.expect: Hard body hit (fast low thump + heavy punch) under a meaty wet splat and squish, a few dark plips.
gore_splat.when: Gory kills with Gore: Full (a blast that tears a critter apart, or a headshot that pops the head off).

melee_hit.expect: Heavy blunt THWACK of a club landing: a big punch with a woody knock in it, a dull body under it and a short wet squelch; no pitched "pock".
melee_hit.when: A club swing connecting with a critter.

gore_limb_pop.expect: Cork-like POP, then a squelch, droplets and a fluff flick.
gore_limb_pop.when: A limb or head coming off.

body_fall.expect: Heavy soft thud crushing dry leaves and grass right at the start, a softer limb slap just after, a small settle; no bounce.
body_fall.when: A body hitting the ground 0.45 s after a critter dies (not after blasts), and the beaver's tail-slap jump landing.

footstep_grass.expect: Soft paw pad, then a dry-grass/leaf crunch ~50 ms later that unfolds a little slowly; loud and easy to locate, still audible (muffled) from behind.

hop.expect: Soft rabbit landing, "pa-DUMP-shh": front paws, hind feet a beat later, a light brush of leaves; no boing, unobtrusive when repeated.
hop.when: Every bunny hop and bunny jump.

jump.expect: Quick upward whoosh with a scuff.

land.when: Landing from a jump or the glider.

glider_open.expect: Big two-stage canopy "fwa-POP": rustling unfurl, loud fabric snap and whump, a second smaller snap, then flutter that slows down.
glider_open.when: Popping the leaf/flower umbrella during the drop.

pickup_ammo.expect: Small clatter, a click, two rising plucked notes.

pickup_health.expect: Bright rising chime sparkle over a warm chord.
pickup_health.when: Picking up or eating a lucky clover.

pickup_armor.expect: Woody acorn knock and clink, then three rising bell tones.

pickup_weapon.expect: Metal latch, then a deep, warm rolled harp chord.

crate_open.expect: Creaking lid and wooden knock, then a breathy wooden-flute flourish (run, trill, held note) with a faint harp chord underneath.
crate_open.when: Opening crates, treasure chests and supply drops.

armor_break.expect: Acorn armor's little mechanism breaking apart: a heavy metal clunk over the shell's crunch, gears stripping ('krrrk'), the clasp snaps open and a bracket clanks off, a small spring sproings loose, then metal bits and screws clatter away.

hurt_squeak.expect: Short, deep, rough critter pain cries (no high squeals): a yelp, "uk-uk" chatter, a growly "grrah", a grunt into a yawp, a raspy whimper-growl, a low "eh-oww".

death_squeak.expect: Real small-animal death squeals (rat recordings slowed to critter size, not synth): a long sinking squeal, an "eek!" then a lower dying squeal, a squeal with one last weak gasp; each ends in a breath.

boss_roar.expect: A monster's roar from a throat the size of a barn: deep, ragged and gargling, rising then falling over ~2.4 s, a sub growl shaking under it and a long outdoor echo. Frightening, not cartoony.
boss_roar.when: Brutus (the island's boss) roaring: when it turns up near a crowd, when it's enraged, and when too many critters crowd it.

boss_screech.expect: A huge, maddened rodent screech: real rat squeals slowed right down and driven hard, with a rasp, ~1.7 s, echoing off glass.
boss_screech.when: Nibbles the Rabid (the Hamster Cage's boss) charging, bursting out of the bedding, and screeching when enraged.

boss_stomp.expect: Something ten critters tall landing: a deep falling boom you feel more than hear, a ground thud, dirt and stones raining back, a rumble rolling away.
boss_stomp.when: A boss's footfall, Ground Pound, leap or landing.

boss_clank.expect: A giant hollow tin toy booming as a foot comes down: inharmonic biscuit-tin modes, loose parts rattling inside, a spring twang, a thud under it.
boss_clank.when: The Tin Tyrant (the Toy Box's boss) stomping, smashing its clamps down and landing.

boss_laser.expect: A rising charge-up whine (~0.7 s), then a buzzing, wobbling beam drone with sizzle and crackle on top, cutting off with a falling zap (~3 s in all).
boss_laser.when: The Tin Tyrant's eye lasers sweeping the floor.

ambient_forest_loop.expect: Gentle breeze and leaves, crickets, occasional birds; seamless 10 s loop.
ambient_forest_loop.when: Background bed for the whole match.

wind_loop.expect: Gusty high-altitude wind with a faint whistle; seamless loop.

storm_loop.expect: Low rumble and swirling wind with a dense, dry thorny crackle and an ominous hum; no clinks or plops; seamless loop.
storm_loop.when: Comes from the nearest edge of the Briar storm wall.

storm_damage_tick.expect: Dry, woody clock tick (tick-TOCK within ~25 ms) with a prickle of thorns; no tone, drone or ring (both takes are the same clock).
storm_damage_tick.when: Each second you take Briar damage.

fire_loop.expect: A fire burning in the open: a low breathing roar, dense fine crackle, woody pops and the odd sharp split, a soft hiss; seamless 8 s loop.
fire_loop.when: The Kernel Hunt's Act I: a ring of the Carrot Patch alight, and the whole Patch burning.

fire_ignite.expect: Something catching all at once: a rising whoomph of air over a soft low thump, then a burst of crackle settling (~2 s).
fire_ignite.when: A ring of the Carrot Patch going up (Act I).

kernel_hum.expect: A warm, faintly unearthly chord that beats slowly and breathes, with a glassy shimmer coming and going on top; quiet; seamless 6 s loop.
kernel_hum.when: The Starfall Kernel hanging over Little Bru at the end of Act I.

wind_key.expect: A wind-up key turned hard: small tin ratchet clicks coming faster and faster over a rising spring whine (~1.3 s).
wind_key.when: The Kernel Hunt's Act II: a Wound rogue winding itself back up, a winding station winding one out.

key_pull.expect: A gritty little metal scrape, a pop, and a cartoon spring 'boing' with a ring of tin (~1 s).
key_pull.when: Pulling the key out of a Wound rogue's back (Act II).

clockwork_loop.expect: Machinery at work: steady tick-tock (two a second), a rough whir of gears swelling and easing, a heavy clunk once round, a breath of steam; seamless 4 s loop.
clockwork_loop.when: Each of the Tin Tyrant's winding stations, while it stands (Act II).

station_break.expect: A tin machine coming apart: a crash and a thud, a long wobbling falling 'sproing', gears and plates clattering down, a couple of loose boings, a last rattle (~2 s).

toy_beep.expect: An old toy's beep: two buzzy square-ish tones, high then higher, through a tiny speaker, then a faint crackle of sparks (~0.8 s).
toy_beep.when: Model No. 7's beep at the end of Act II.

ui_hover.expect: Soft, whimsical harp glissando swipe (5 quick rising notes into a ringing high note), under 0.35 s.

match_countdown_go.expect: Brighter two-tone "GO!" beep with a bell ring.

victory_fanfare.expect: Rock sting in D: snare pickup, one bar of distorted power-chord riff over a kick/snare rock beat, a dead stop with a tom fill + reverse cymbal, then the loudest moment: a huge low D chord + kick/snare/crash, held with a tin-whistle run to a high D, fading out by 3 s.
victory_fanfare.when: Winner Winner Carrot Dinner! (starts with the victory music, same key and tempo).

music/menu_monkeys_spinning_monkeys.mp3.title: Monkeys Spinning Monkeys
music/menu_monkeys_spinning_monkeys.mp3.expect: Light, happy flutes and pizzicato — cartoon woodland.

music/match_run_amok.mp3.title: Run Amok
music/match_run_amok.mp3.expect: Orchestral comedy chase with lots of energy.

music/match_bushwick_tarantella.mp3.title: Bushwick Tarantella
music/match_bushwick_tarantella.mp3.expect: Frantic accordion and clarinet — final-circle panic.

music/victory_fiddles_mcginty.mp3.title: Fiddles McGinty
music/victory_fiddles_mcginty.mp3.expect: Driving Celtic folk-rock reel: pipes, recorder, guitar, rock backbeat.
music/victory_fiddles_mcginty.mp3.when: Victory screen (fades in under the victory_fanfare sting).

music/cage_pixel_peeker_polka.mp3.title: Pixel Peeker Polka (faster)
music/cage_pixel_peeker_polka.mp3.expect: Bouncy chiptune polka: an 8-bit toy box that never sits still.

music/cage_itty_bitty_8_bit.mp3.title: Itty Bitty 8 Bit
music/cage_itty_bitty_8_bit.mp3.expect: Bright little square-wave tune, wind-up-toy cheerful.

music/cage_voxel_revolution.mp3.title: Voxel Revolution
music/cage_voxel_revolution.mp3.expect: Grooving synth-pop chiptune with a driving beat.

music/toybox_vivacity.mp3.title: Vivacity
music/toybox_vivacity.mp3.expect: Happy, peppy vibraphone, bass and organ; no brass.

music/toybox_divertimento_k131.mp3.title: Divertimento K131
music/toybox_divertimento_k131.mp3.expect: Music-box bells, chimes, harp and celesta (Mozart); no brass.

music/boss_volatile_reaction.mp3.title: Volatile Reaction
music/boss_volatile_reaction.mp3.expect: Blasting brass and pounding percussion in 7/4: fight music with a grin.
music/boss_volatile_reaction.mp3.when: A Boss Battle, from the moment the boss turns up (random pick).

music/boss_killers.mp3.title: Killers
music/boss_killers.mp3.expect: Guitar, choir and strings, big from the first bar.
music/boss_killers.mp3.when: A Boss Battle, from the moment the boss turns up (random pick).
